character.appendages: The two upper tufts are contour features of the same body. They fold, separate and trail with the body but never become limbs.
character.contactAndOrigin: Native canvas is 64x64 with source origin [24,42]. Most poses contact near y=42-44; cell_062 is deliberately offset far right and must retain that local placement.
character.faceAndExpression: Two small yellow facial lights sit low on the front. They separate, compress, merge visually at native scale or become occluded according to pose; there is no fixed pasted face.
character.locomotion: The complete body bobs, compresses, curls, stretches vertically, sweeps horizontally and collapses flat. No donor action semantics are renamed or invented.
character.morphology: Tiny limbless soft soot-drop: one continuous rounded body with two pointed upper tufts. No arms, legs, feet, wings or separate tail; tall cells stretch the whole body into a crescent.
character.restraint: Main cells 027-043 form the restrained block, including sameAs aliases. Gold binding wraps the central body and follows compact, tall crescent and flat orientations while leaving face and upper tufts free.
character.specialStates: Cells 044/046 are orange-red, 047/048 black silhouettes, 061 stone-gray and 064 white evolution silhouette. These are deterministic derivations where contours permit.
